---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the skill, templates or docs
labels: [enhancement]
---

### Problem

What were you trying to ship when the skill fell short? A concrete
failure mode beats a wishlist item.

### Proposed solution

What should change, and where — SKILL.md, templates/voice.md, the docs,
the test protocol?

### Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed, including solving it outside the skill.

### Additional context

Links, transcripts, hook panels or test results that support the idea.

### Checklist

- [ ] I started or continued this idea in GitHub Discussions (feature
      ideas land there first, per CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I checked existing issues and discussions for a duplicate
- [ ] The change keeps the documented counts consistent (47 hook
      formulas = 21 + 26, 5 phases, 12 principles, 16 QA points,
      10 onboarding questions)
